guidance.sentence: We expect free cash flow to remain strong in the fourth quarter and increase meaningfully in 2027 compared with 2026.
We expect free cash flow to remain strong in the fourth quarter and increase meaningfully in 2027 compared with 2026.

In Drilling Services, we expect to operate an average of approximately 104 rigs in the United States during the fourth quarter and exit 2026 above that level, with additional rig reactivations anticipated in the first quarter of 2027.
Overall, we expect Drilling Services adjusted gross profit of $150 million in the fourth quarter.
In Completion Services, we expect fourth quarter adjusted gross profit of $140 million, supported by activity levels broadly consistent with the third quarter and additional pricing improvements.

As we deploy new Emerald 100% natural gas powered equipment, we will continue to decommission diesel-powered assets and therefore do not expect active horsepower to increase through the first half of 2027.

In Drilling Products, we expect fourth quarter adjusted gross profit to decline 5-10%, sequentially, primarily reflecting the expectation for lower drilling activity in Saudi Arabia due to ongoing geopolitical unrest in the region.
We expect Other adjusted gross profit in the fourth quarter to be steady compared to the third quarter.

summary: Patterson-UTI expects Q4 2026 adjusted gross profit of $150 million in Drilling Services and $140 million in Completion Services, a 5-10% sequential decline in Drilling Products, about 104 average U.S. rigs, strong Q4 free cash flow and a meaningful free cash flow increase in 2027.
